'''Nooli''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> located in the [[Nooli system/Legends|Nooli system]] in the [[Noolian sector/Legends|Noolian sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:Noolian_Crisis.png|thumb|left|175px|The [[Noolian Crisis]].]]
Following the fall of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] invaded Nooli, [[Galboron]], and several worlds in the outskirts of [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. They were eventually defeated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Galboron]]. The conflict was named [[Noolian Crisis]] after the planet Nooli.<ref name="TEGtW" />
